articles.title: Two rival Ethereum proposals aim to stop Glamsterdam breaking old contracts
articles.snippet: The proposals aim to keep Ethereum’s planned gas changes from breaking existing contracts, using different approaches to what contracts see and what users pay.

articles.title: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
articles.snippet: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.

articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin Said Its Hack Was Contained, But Blockchain Data Tells a Different Story
articles.snippet: Fresh forensic analysis traces $48.6 million across 11 blockchains and finds thousands of customer deposit addresses drained hours after the Brazilian exchange said it had stopped the breach on Monday.
